messages:
mara: urgent DSAR + vuln overlap. Legal wants export for forensics but not full deletion yet. Can ops run a minimal, auditable export with a temporary KMS grant?
cheng: yes. create ephemeral role dsar-export-4201 (TTL 12h) with kms:Decrypt on exact CMK ARN and s3:PutObject to s3://privacy-evidence/4201/. Do not alter key policy.
iza: add CloudTrail routing and object tagging: erasure-case=4201 and set Object Lock GOVERNANCE on uploads. We need an immutable manifest for legal.
tara-privacy: file retention-exception RE-601 if we hold beyond DSAR window. CISO approval required for >24h. Need exporter identity and timestamps recorded.
ciso: I approve a 24h hold assuming exports are immutable and no reingest. Post final audit manifest here.
audit-bot: [AUDIT] role dsar-export-4201 assumed by cheng at 4201234569; actions: kms:Decrypt(3), s3:PutObject(2). Logs forwarded to s3://evidence-lock/4201/.
mara: export completed: s3://privacy-evidence/4201/export-2026-04-01.tar.gz. exporter=cheng, role=dsar-export-4201, keys=cmk-77, duration=00:12:43. Tara please file RE-601 if needed.
tara-privacy: filing RE-601 now; attaching audit manifest and evidence link. Thanks team.
